summary: Triangular island at a Moggill Road slip-road junction; nowhere to stop.

drivers.seclusion: Apartments 17 m away and a busy road junction on every side.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb is a slip-lane island beside a railway bridge; no room to pull out of the lane.
drivers.traffic: Moggill Road arterial, slip lane and bus zone; loud.
drivers.convention: No Stopping Any Time and Bus Zone signs nearby; no parked cars.

sun_shade: Trees shade the west and the bridge overhead; open to the south.
